readmeMarkdown:
AGY Doctor

One-command cross-platform diagnostics for Google Antigravity

English · 简体中文

--- **AGY Doctor** diagnoses the most common real-world failures in **Google Antigravity** (Desktop 2.0, IDE, and CLI `agy`) across Windows, macOS, and Linux — with **zero npm dependencies** and **zero modifications to `app.asar`**. ## What It Catches | Check | Root Cause Caught | | :--- | :--- | | **Node.js Runtime** | Node `< 20` breaking modern MCP & hook plugins (`agy-fast`, `agent-guard`) | | **Node GUI PATH** | macOS Dock-launched client missing Homebrew/NVM `node`, so hooks silently no-op | | **Client Install Path** | Non-system-drive Windows installs that break background updates and trigger *"Agent terminated due to error"* | | **Chinese Localization** | Client auto-updates silently overwriting `app.asar` while leaving `app.asar.bak` behind (includes automatic `SessionStart` banner) | | **Git `worktreeConfig`** | `extensions.worktreeConfig=true` causing Antigravity's built-in git parser to drop workspace metadata or freeze | | **Direct Reachability** | Latency & reachability checks against `cloudcode-pa.googleapis.com`, `oauth2.googleapis.com`, `github.com`, and `npmjs.org` | | **Proxy Alignment** | Mismatch between OS proxy (`Internet Settings` / `scutil --proxy` / `gsettings`), local proxy ports (`7890`, `7897`, `10808`...), and `git http.proxy` | | **Shell Profile Noise** | Broken `conda` / shell startup lines polluting every `run_command` output and wasting tokens | | **Plugin Manifests** | Malformed `plugin.json` / `mcp_config.json` / `hooks.json` or duplicate plugin `name` collisions | ## Quick Install **Requirements:** Node.js >= 20, Git. **Windows (PowerShell):** ```powershell irm https://raw.githubusercontent.com/Echoqili/agy-doctor/main/install.ps1 | iex ``` **macOS / Linux:** ```bash curl -fsSL https://raw.githubusercontent.com/Echoqili/agy-doctor/main/install.sh | sh ``` **npm / npx** (no Git required — installs into `~/.gemini/config/plugins` and runs self-tests): ```bash npx -y @echoqili/agy-doctor agy plugin enable agy-doctor ``` > **macOS note:** if launched from Dock/Finder, the GUI process may not include Homebrew/NVM's `node` on its `PATH`, so hooks silently do nothing. Start Antigravity from a terminal, or run `launchctl setenv PATH "/opt/homebrew/bin:/usr/local/bin:$PATH"` and restart. `agy-doctor` reports this as "Node.js GUI PATH". ## Usage Ask the agent directly in chat: - *"Run a health check on Antigravity"* - *"Agent keeps saying terminated due to error, help me diagnose"* - *"git clone keeps failing, check my network and proxy"* Or run from terminal: ```bash node ~/.gemini/config/plugins/agy-doctor/scripts/doctor.mjs --dir . node ~/.gemini/config/plugins/agy-doctor/scripts/doctor.mjs --json ``` ## License [MIT](LICENSE)
latestReleaseNotes:
Initial release of **agy-doctor**: one-command, cross-platform health diagnostics for Google Antigravity.

9 checks covering the most common real-world failures:
- Node.js version (<20 breaks modern plugins) and Node GUI PATH visibility on macOS (Dock-launched clients missing Homebrew/NVM node).
- Antigravity install path (non-system-drive updates) and app.asar version.
- Chinese localization overwrite detection + automatic `SessionStart` banner.
- `git extensions.worktreeConfig` incompatibility.
- Direct reachability of Google API / OAuth / GitHub / npm endpoints.
- System vs local proxy alignment (Windows registry / macOS scutil / Linux gsettings).
- Shell profile stderr noise wasting tokens.
- Plugin manifest parse errors and duplicate-name collisions.

Zero npm dependencies, no `app.asar` modification. One-line installers (`install.ps1` / `install.sh`) with macOS GUI PATH fallback.

Validated with `agy plugin validate --strict` — zero warnings. Full docs: README.md / README.zh-CN.md.
